senses.gloss:
सौप्तिक a. (की f.)
1 Connected
with or relating to sleep.
--2
Somniferous.
--कं A night-attack, an
attack on sleeping men.
--Comp.
--पर्वन् n. N. of the tenth parvan or
book of the Mahābhārata which
relates how Aśvatthāman,
Kṛtavarman and Kṛpa-the only
surviving Kuru warriors-attacked by
night the Pāṇḍava camp and
slaughtered thousands of warriors
while asleep.
--वधः the great
nocturnal slaughter of Pāṇḍava camp
(above referred to); मार्गो ह्येष
नरेंद्रसौप्तिकवधे पूर्वं कृतो द्रौणिना Mk. 3. 11.
